business_question: Which months create the largest revenue planning risk?
key_pattern: Mid-year and January show recurring negative MoM swings; volatility signal flags > 20% MoM moves.

business_question: Which states are most under-represented relative to economic size?
key_pattern: MG (~12%) and PR (~5%) trail their share of national GDP, indicating under-representation rather than market diversification.

business_question: How dependent is revenue on the highest-value buyers?
key_pattern: Top decile holds 38% of revenue; cumulative share reaches ~64% by decile 3, showing a steep concentration curve.

business_question: How is revenue split between upfront and installment cash inflows?
key_pattern: Installment-share of revenue (~64%) is the dominant cash-timing signal; per-order installment depth (4.12) is modest by Brazilian baseline.
